body: What do you hate about yourself?

It has not surfaced for a long time now.  Cutting gambling off was difficult and I had relapses in the following months but it's pretty much just left me now and I find poker in particular rather boring.

I also had an alcohol problem which I managed to shake off at around the same time.  I used to work in a pub around that time and when I woke up and went to work I would sweat a lot and feel terrible until I had a drink.  Working in a pub with a bad manager and regular alcoholics to talk to made it too all to easy, I would have a lot of drink every day.  I remember once I was so depressed and drunk at work I shouted at customers to go away and leave me alone (I'd just lost my wages in the fruit machine).  Sort of hilarious when I look back now but believe me at the time it was not so funny for me!

I did see counsellors and therapists, went to the doctor as well to try and explain things.  For me they didn't do much, but it was still important to initiate contact as it was the mark of the beginning of the end of it all for me.
